models.name: Original Chudjak
models.material: Felt, cotton shirting and embroidered thread
models.description: An unimpressed face behind thick glasses. One soft hand lifts for a reluctant wave.
models.alt: Seated Chudjak doll with felt hair, thick glasses, sewn shirt and rounded feet.

models.name: Midnight Hoodie
models.material: Charcoal jersey with ribbed cotton cuffs
models.description: He tugs at a lined hood. The cords take a beat to settle against his chest.
models.alt: Bespectacled Chudjak in a charcoal hood with a deep lining and two hanging drawstrings.

models.name: Helmet Chudjak
models.material: Olive twill, webbing and padded felt
models.description: A padded field helmet slips with the tilt of his head. One hand nudges it back.
models.alt: Chudjak plush in a paneled olive helmet with a chin strap and a utility overshirt.

models.name: Patchwork Afterhours
models.material: Pieced cotton with blanket-stitched repairs
models.description: Cream, burgundy and graphite panels pull together in a brief self-hug. One knee wears a repair.
models.alt: Patchwork Chudjak toy with a repaired knee, mismatched cuff and stitched fabric panels.

models.name: Silver Thread
models.material: Dark velour, satin and silver embroidery
models.description: A shoulder turn catches the silver embroidery. The zipper pull swings against the satin collar.
models.alt: Chudjak in a dark satin bomber jacket with a separate zipper pull and silver stitching.

models.name: Velvet Eclipse
models.material: Violet velvet with moon-gray lining and woven trim
models.description: He draws a velvet hood around his glasses, lowers it and gives a small wave.
models.alt: Violet velvet Chudjak with a lined hood, a moon-gray interior and a familiar deadpan face.

models.name: Desk Green
models.material: Moss-green molded PBT, cream stem and brushed steel
models.description: Raised sleepy eyes sit above a broad terracotta lip. A single press compresses the switch.
models.alt: Sculpted green Pepe keycap with sleepy raised eyes, a cream stem and a grounded metal socket.

models.name: Terminal Clear
models.material: Translucent jade polycarbonate and brass spring
models.description: The stepped clear wall exposes the spring. A point of light rises through the jade as it releases.
models.alt: Clear jade frog keycap with a visible internal stem and brass spring.

models.name: Night Shift
models.material: Graphite and ivory two-shot plastic
models.description: A small moon sits in the graphite cap. The far eye opens under load and settles back.
models.alt: Graphite and ivory sculpted frog keycap with a crescent inset beside the raised eyes.

models.name: Porcelain Pond
models.material: Ivory ceramic glaze, celadon and gold repair lines
models.description: Painted reeds curl around the ceramic face. A fine gold seam catches the light on release.
models.alt: Ivory glazed frog keycap with a celadon face and a fine gold repair seam.

models.name: Meteor Core
models.material: Faceted ironstone, polished nickel and amber resin
models.description: A warm inclusion sits inside the cut mineral shell. One reflection circles the inset.
models.alt: Dark faceted mineral frog cap with a bright amber inclusion and polished metal stem.

models.name: Black Opal Eclipse
models.material: Carved opal, silver and smoked metal
models.description: The opal cap lifts clear of its stem, revealing an eclipse, then seats itself in the switch.
models.alt: Dark opalescent frog keycap with a silver crescent over a smoked-metal switch housing.

models.name: Graphite Session
models.material: Graphite ABS, cream paper and oxide tape
models.description: The take-up hub gathers the recorded side while the supply pack unwinds.
models.alt: Charcoal cassette with a cream label, open hub teeth and red oxide tape.

models.name: Clear Leader
models.material: Smoke-jade acrylic, copper guides and clear leader
models.description: The clear wall exposes two unequal tape packs. An amber leader joint crosses the center window.
models.alt: See-through jade cassette with exposed reels, metal tape guides and an amber splice.

models.name: Splice Repair
models.material: Worn ochre plastic, splicing tape and ink
models.description: Diagonal repair tape bridges a scuffed shell. A marked edit catches in the window, then slips through.
models.alt: Ochre cassette with adhesive repair strips and a handwritten red splice mark.

models.name: Brushed Deck
models.material: Brushed aluminum, machined hubs and steel screws
models.description: A narrow reflection crosses the faceplate while the dark hubs take up the tape.
models.alt: Pale metal cassette with four countersunk screws and dark machined reels.

models.name: Night Press
models.material: Violet screen print, silver foil and gold ink
models.description: A gold moon rests on the label. The foil registration cross turns with the take-up hub.
models.alt: Violet art-label cassette with a printed horizon, gold moon and foil marks.

models.name: Field Enamel
models.material: Jade enameled steel, brass valve and gauge glass
models.description: The handwheel cracks open. The needle lifts and a short plume dissolves above the regulator.
models.alt: Jade pressure cylinder on a molded foot, with a brass handwheel and a cream gauge.

models.name: Sight Glass
models.material: Borosilicate glass, a brass cage and a ceramic float
models.description: The liquid level and float settle behind the clear wall when the regulator opens.
models.alt: Transparent reservoir in a brass cage with a visible float and liquid meniscus.

models.name: Field Repair
models.material: Oxide-red steel, canvas straps and riveted patches
models.description: The repaired wing knob lifts. A taped joint exhales above the khaki field strap.
models.alt: Oxide-red cylinder with a riveted patch, khaki reinforcement and a repaired regulator.

models.name: Kiln White
models.material: Ivory ceramic, copper wire and cobalt enamel
models.description: The copper wheel meters a breath of vapor past the warm shoulder seam.
models.alt: Ivory ceramic tank with copper reinforcement, a cobalt gauge and a grounded foot ring.

models.name: They’ll Text Back
models.material: Storm glass, brass and copper silk
models.description: An umbrella opens under pressure. Three vapor dots appear where a reply should be.
models.alt: Blue glass cigar with a weather chamber, copper umbrella and a dial. Three typing dots rise from the ember.

models.name: One More Game
models.material: Indigo bellows, copper ferrules and ivory enamel
models.description: A sprung sleeve compresses, pushes the gauge past its stop and exhales a retry curl.
models.alt: Ribbed indigo cigar with a telescoping barrel, checker band and smoke curling back into an arrow.

models.name: Next in Queue
models.material: Violet glass, silver foil and tuned brass
models.description: Three reeds flex behind a window and release one note of hold music.
models.alt: Violet pressure cigar with a slotted reed window, silver fittings and a musical note of vapor.

models.name: It Was Lag
models.material: Graphite enamel, amber resin and gold trim
models.description: The guard lifts, the delayed needle jumps, and the interrupted conduit exhales a broken signal.
models.alt: Gray cigar cartridge with an amber switch guard, a warning band and three broken signal arcs.

models.name: Still Early
models.material: Smoked jade, nacre, rose gold and pink opal
models.description: Pressure exposes the mineral inclusion. A pink price line climbs briefly above the barrel.
models.alt: Pearl-paneled jade cigar with an opal window and rose-gold gauge. A rosy vapor line climbs and fades.

models.name: Last Excuse
models.material: Blackened brass, amber glass and opal
models.description: Two chambers trade pressure through a balancing link. Their opposing wisps cross at the opal seam.
models.alt: A split-chamber cigar with amber and opal reservoirs, a balancing linkage and two crossing wisps.

models.name: Greenline
models.material: Olive ABS, phosphor glass and steel
models.description: A small disk seats in the drive and a green cursor blinks on the curved screen.
models.alt: Olive pocket computer with a recessed disk slot, bright green CRT and separate keys.

models.name: Amber Relay
models.material: Bakelite, thermal paper and amber glass
models.description: The clamshell printer rolls a receipt through its brass feed.
models.alt: Ochre handheld terminal with amber glass, a hinged case and a moving slip of paper.

models.name: Field Service
models.material: Rubber bumpers, brushed alloy and blue LCD
models.description: The antenna extends and a waveform crosses the field technician’s screen.
models.alt: Reinforced blue-gray portable terminal with a telescoping antenna, exposed screws and a waveform.

models.name: Glass Console
models.material: Amethyst polycarbonate and magnetic tape
models.description: A tiny magnetic reel drives a second display beneath the translucent shell.
models.alt: Clear violet pocket console with two inset screens and a visible tape reel.

models.name: Marginalia
models.material: Ochre cover stock, cotton thread and copper ink
models.description: The stitched cover parts to show a copper monograph in the page margin.
models.alt: Ochre pocket zine with an exposed stitched spine, turned paper corner and copper marginal mark.

models.name: Clasped Copy
models.material: Cordovan leather, brass hardware and laid paper
models.description: A small clasp turns out of its keyhole before the leather board opens.
models.alt: Cordovan leather pocket book with an articulated brass clasp and a narrow keyhole.

models.name: Night Binding
models.material: Midnight vellum, silk ribbon and silver foil
models.description: A silver thumb index catches the light and the ribbon follows the lifted page.
models.alt: Midnight blue volume with a pale vellum insert, silver thumb index and a separate bookmark ribbon.

models.name: Opal Frontispiece
models.material: Ivory cloth, nacre and mirrored silver
models.description: A nacre lens opens on a silver mirror page set inside the blue-black boards.
models.alt: Blue-black pocket book with an ivory spine and an opal lens above a silver mirror page.
